mb_karve_mast_desc: A nimble, quality sail and mast assembly to harness the wind. Rigged for agile coastal navigation and navigating tight waterways where bigger ships dare not tread. <color=yellow>Fast enough to outrun a leech, but don't go picking fights with sea serpents in this little rig!</color>
mb_pier_desc: Pier support that is built on water and automatically extends all the way to the sea floor.
mb_raft_desc: A raft... that you can build on!
mb_vikingship_mast_desc: A majestic, full-rigged longship sail and mast assembly. Features authentic furling and unfurling rigging capable of catching prevailing ocean winds with formidable speed. <color=yellow>Woven coarse linen and sturdy heartwood to carry hardy Vikings across uncharted oceans.</color>
valheim_vehicles_drakkalship_mast_desc: A massive, flame-hardened warship sail and mast assembly from the southern seas. Outfitted with heavy-duty Ashlands rigging built to withstand boiling swells and scorching gales. <color=yellow>Woven from enchanted threads to drive heavy dreadnoughts through the stormiest seas.</color>
valheim_vehicles_wheel_tutorial_flight: In flight mode: [Jump] to ascend. [Crouch] to descend.
valheim_vehicles_keel_desc: A sea-sturdy center hull piece. Time to build a sturdy ship. Made of basic Wood. A structural extension piece used to lengthen the main keel. <color=yellow>More belly for the beast. Keep it tight, unless ye like a soggy cargo hold.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_slab_desc: A Hull Slab made for ships.
valheim_vehicles_hull_wall_desc: A Hull Wall made for ships.
valheim_vehicles_material_iron_yggdrasil: Made of Banded Iron and Reinforced Wood. Impervious to heat.
valheim_vehicles_hull_rib_corner_desc: Will seal off the ship when used with a Hull Prow and a Hull Rib.
valheim_vehicles_inverse_desc: Inverse/Flipped Roof variant of hull piece.
valheim_vehicles_hull_rib_corner_floor_d: Will seal off the ship's rib corner gap.
valheim_vehicles_hull_rib_prow_desc: A Hull-Rib Piece meant to be placed at the front of a ship.
valheim_vehicles_hull_rib_aft_desc: A Hull-Rib Piece meant to be placed at the back of a ship.
valheim_vehicles_hull_rib_expander_desc: A Hull-Rib Piece meant to widen the ship so the ship can grow larger. Connects with other rib pieces on outside.
valheim_vehicles_hull_rib_prow_variant_c: Prow Cutter - meant for a heavier ship look and feel.
valheim_vehicles_hull_rib_prow_variant_s: Prow Sleek - meant for a sleeker look and feel.
valheim_vehicles_hull_prow_seal_desc: Seals the front nose of the vehicle when using prow variants.
valheim_vehicles_hull_aft_seal_desc: Seals the aft of the vehicle when using aft rib pieces.
valheim_vehicles_hull_rib_side_desc: A Hull-Rib Side piece. Useful for building realistic hulls
valheim_vehicles_rudder_advanced_desc: Standard rudder design, +[7.5] row speed | Turn angle: 60° | Turn speed: 0.66x. An advanced rear-mounted rudder for superior maneuverability. <color=yellow>Now we're steering with purpose! Grease those hinges with fat and try to look like a proper captain.</color>
valheim_vehicles_rudder_must_attach_boat: Rudder must be attached directly to the hull of the boat.
valheim_vehicles_rudder_orientation_inva: Rudder must face the same direction as the steering wheel.
valheim_vehicles_wheel_orientation_inval: Steering wheel must face the same direction as the rudder.
valheim_vehicles_seat_orientation_invali: The rowing seat must face forward in the same direction as the ship's rudders and steering wheel!
valheim_vehicles_greydwarf_rowing_seat_d: A rowing bench configured for a sailor Greydwarf. Can be placed freely clipping into hull geometry. Facing direction must align forward with the ship. Seated Greydwarves dynamically deploy an oar and propel the ship forward at flat speeds (Regular +1.0, Shaman +1.5, Brute +2.0). Players can also sit to rest.
valheim_vehicles_ram_stake_desc: Used to puncture hulls, enemies, and terrain. Less area damage, but can smash rocks harder within a small area. Cannot damage trees.
valheim_vehicles_ram_blade_desc: Used to shred enemies and terrain. Deals concussive pickaxe damage damage to rocks and can slash enemies. Can hurt trees
valheim_vehicles_ram_nose_desc: Use to smash terrain and enemies
valheim_vehicles_gui_vehicle_is_beached: The Vehicle is beached. Dig until your vehicle can reach water.
valheim_vehicles_water_mask_desc: Use this to hide water on the ship. Requires 8 pieces placed to make a cube around the area. This will not bend the water, but it will make the ship clear of water where it's put.
valheim_vehicles_window_floor_porthole_d: Reinforced porthole window floor. Protects from most things.
valheim_vehicles_window_porthole_standal: Porthole window that can be placed on any vehicle piece to see through it. Requires 2 windows to create a proper seal.
valheim_vehicles_land_vehicle_desc: A placeable land vehicle. Explore the lands of valheim with a vehicle!
valheim_vehicles_custom_tread_distance_d: Use this to set the distance between treads for the specific vehicle. Place two cubes to set the distance of the treads. This will override any global config value set for max tread sizes and will always use this distance centered to the vehicle. The vehicle then will require usage of these cubes to update treads.
valheim_vehicles_custom_height_tool_desc: Place 1 cube to control the vehicle height cutoff. This will allow configuring max vehicle height per ship allowing excluding masts from physics calcs and disregard global config. The vehicle will then require placement of a new cube to update it's local height cutoff.
valheim_vehicles_hammer_description: With this hammer you can build and repair your boat.
valheim_vehicles_portal_not_supported: Portals on boats are not supported. Use the Horn of Loki to teleport to/from the boat.
valheim_vehicles_custom_floatation_tool_: Customize the floatation height per vehicle. Wherever this is place becomes the new float point. Adding another cube will remove the last cube.
valheim_vehicles_custom_mast_desc: A custom mast meant to simplify vehicle masts. These do not contain sails, but they can be equipped with a custom sail easily.
valheim_vehicles_mechanism_swivel_desc: A mechanism that allows for rotating and moving items on a vehicle or anywhere independently.
valheim_vehicles_mechanism_power_pylon_d: Allows for sharing power within a specific radius. Collects unstable electricity.
valheim_vehicles_mechanism_power_source_: Engines supply LandVehicles with power and other mechanisms. Without an engine fuel players will have to haul their vehicle.

Generates mystical Eitr energy from refined resources. Connects to adjacent storage units to power magical ship systems and recharge magical abilities in the late game. <color=yellow>Harnessing raw magic on a wooden deck? What could possibly go wrong?</color>
valheim_vehicles_mechanism_power_storage: Stores high capacities of pure Eitr power generated aboard your vessel. Build charge and drain plates adjacent to this battery to manage magical reserves. <color=yellow>A massive battery of buzzing arcane energy. Don't lick the terminals.</color>
valheim_vehicles_mechanism_power_charge_: Must be built adjacent to an Eitr Power Storage battery. Rapidly channels stored Eitr energy directly into standing players. Time to cast some real magic. <color=yellow>Step right up and feel the tingle! Refills your inner spark in seconds.</color>
valheim_vehicles_mechanism_power_drain_p: Must be built adjacent to an Eitr Power Storage battery. Safely siphons a standing player's regenerated Eitr to recharge the battery reserves for later use. <color=yellow>Stand here to feed the ship yer magical juices. Don't worry, it tickles only a little.</color>
valheim_vehicles_dock_anchor_point_desc: The attachment point for land-vehicles to dock between a boat. Only one of these should be added per vehicle. This will connect when the vehicle is manually or automatically docked to the vehicle.
valheim_vehicles_config_tread_distance_d: Treads Distance (distance between treads) affects physics. Makes the vehicle more like a motor bike at lower values. Can be negative values to allow overlapping.
valheim_vehicles_config_treads_scale_des: Treads Scale makes each tread wider/thinner
valheim_vehicles_treads_max_length: Treads Max Length (distance front to back)
valheim_vehicles_item_cannon_handheld_it: All the power of a cannon but you are the turret. Requires cannonballs in your inventory to fire.
valheim_vehicles_item_telescope_desc: Control nearby turrets if there is a control center nearby.
valheim_vehicles_cannonball_solid_desc: An solid cannonball. Can tear through multiple layers of a structure damaging everything in it's path. Different materials slow down it's speed and damage
valheim_vehicles_cannonball_explosive_de: An explosive cannonball. Cannot penetrate structures but it can do massive damage across an impact area.
valheim_vehicles_item_telescope_handheld: telescope to zoom in and target enemies from afar. Allows calling long-range attacks from autonomous cannons and switching targeting between specific enemies and structures.
valheim_vehicles_cannon_control_center_p: Cannon Turret Controller cannon be placed within a vehicle. Vehicles automatically have this capability.
valheim_vehicles_cannon_controls_tutoria: [Block] + W/S to control cannons pitch, A/D to switch cannon groups.
valheim_vehicles_cannon_control_center_t:
Hold [Block] to adjust controls. Tap Block to Fire (must be less than 0.5s hold).
Forward/Backward to adjust tilt
Left/Right to change groups.
Groups based on orientation of vehicle or control center.
 (1-4) 1=Forward 2=Backward 3=Left 4=Right
valheim_vehicles_hull_rail_desc: Keeps you in your ship. Works with all hulls and stacks. Make cages, elevators, or high walls using these.
valheim_vehicles_hull_with_keel_desc: A slab with a hull keel. Meant to seamlessly connect with rib pieces. Typically used in center of vehicle. Aesthetic only outside of defensive properties.
valheim_vehicles_hull_seal_desc: Seals the corresponding hull rib piece
valheim_vehicles_boundary_mesh_eraser_de: Delete the boundary mesh. These can be viewed in the vehicle physics debugger
valheim_vehicles_boundary_mesh_desc: Vehicle Boundary Mesh allows constraining the boundary of the vehicle within the placed mesh. This will allow any prefab placed to expand until it exceed the area of the boundary.
valheim_vehicles_hull_rib_aft_right_wood: Nailed Hull Rear Counter Stern - Right
valheim_vehicles_water_vehicle_desc: The starting piece for the boat. You can build other parts on top of it. The foundational central spine for constructing a custom ship. <color=yellow>The spine of yer future pride and joy. Lay it straight, lest ye want a ship that swims like a drunken neck.</color>
valheim_vehicles_rudder_basic_desc: Makeshift rudder design, +[4] row speed | Turn angle: 30° | Turn speed: 0.33x. A basic side-mounted steering oar. <color=yellow>Barely better than a paddle, but it'll keep ye from spinning in circles like a headless neck.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_bow_tri_left_wood_: A Hull-Rib Piece meant to be placed at the front of a ship. A sturdy port-side forward rib secured with bronze nails for heavy defensive integrity. <color=yellow>Sharp and sturdy on the port side, ready to ram whatever foul beast looks at us funny.</color>
mb_rope_ladder_desc: A simple ladder made out of ropes and planks. A deployable climbing net constructed from woven fiber, allowing easy boarding from the water. <color=yellow>Heave yerself aboard before a serpent decides yer looking like a tasty snack.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_rail_25deg_wood_de: Keeps you in your ship. Works with all hulls and stacks. Make cages, elevators, or high walls using these. An angled railing piece crafted to seamlessly match a gentle curvature. <color=yellow>Follows the gentle slope of the hull. Pure craftsmanship at sea.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_rib_corner_floor_w: Will seal off the ship's rib corner gap. A tapered port-side floor panel that fits securely into the narrowing bow. <color=yellow>Don't leave a hole up front unless ye fancy a saltwater bath in yer sleep.</color>
mb_boarding_ramp_wide_desc: Extend and retract the ramp. An extra-wide retractable boarding ramp ideal for transferring carts and heavy cargo. <color=yellow>Plenty of room to haul yer plundered loot aboard without stubbing a toe.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_rib_corner_floor_w: Will seal off the ship's rib corner gap. A tapered starboard-side floor panel that fits securely into the narrowing bow. <color=yellow>One more plank between you and a freezing, watery grave. Bless the trees.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_rail_45deg_wood_de: Keeps you in your ship. Works with all hulls and stacks. Make cages, elevators, or high walls using these. A steeply angled railing piece designed to secure highly elevated sections. <color=yellow>A steep climb for a steep bow. Hold on tight when we hit the swells!</color>
valheim_vehicles_cannon_fixed_tier1_desc: A fixed cannon to defend your ship. Fired manually from the gunnery Binnacle. Must be near a powder barrel and cannonball ammo in a storage container to fire. <color=yellow>Point the shiny end at the enemy and try not to blow our own mast off!</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_bow_tri_right_wood: A Hull-Rib Piece meant to be placed at the front of a ship. A sturdy starboard-side forward rib secured with bronze nails for heavy defensive integrity. <color=yellow>Sharp and sturdy on the starboard side. Prepare for ramming speed!</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_rib_aft_left_wood_: A Hull-Rib Piece meant to be placed at the back of a ship. A reinforced port-side counter piece for the overhanging upper stern structure. <color=yellow>Finishing off the port aft. Make sure those nails are driven deep.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_seal_tri_bow_right: Seals the front nose of the vehicle when using prow variants. A specialized starboard-side panel nailed in place to provide a sealed bow surface. <color=yellow>Snugs right up to the bow so we don't scoop up half the sea.</color>
valheim_vehicles_rudder_standard_desc: Standard rudder design, +[7.5] row speed | Turn angle: 60° | Turn speed: 0.66x. An advanced rear-mounted rudder for superior maneuverability. <color=yellow>Now we're steering with purpose! Grease those hinges with fat and try to look like a proper captain.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_rib_aft_right_wood: A Hull-Rib Piece meant to be placed at the back of a ship. A reinforced starboard-side counter piece for the overhanging upper stern structure. <color=yellow>Finishing off the starboard aft. Makes the ship look right pretty as we sail away.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_center_desc: A sea-sturdy center hull piece. Time to build a sturdy ship. A structural extension piece used to lengthen the main keel. <color=yellow>More belly for the beast. Keep it tight, unless ye like a soggy cargo hold.</color>
mb_dirt_floor_2x2_desc: Dirt to plant seeds into and harvest plants from. A spacious deck-mounted cultivation bed providing ample fertile soil. <color=yellow>A proper floating farm. Just don't let the boars loose on deck.</color>
mb_dirt_floor_1x1_desc: Dirt to plant seeds into and harvest plants from. A compact, soil-filled wooden box treated to withstand salt water. <color=yellow>A tiny patch of earth to grow yer turnips. Scurvy ain't pretty, mates.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_rib_aft_center_woo: A Hull-Rib Piece meant to be placed at the back of a ship. The central, reinforced stern frame providing a solid mounting point for heavy rudders. <color=yellow>A grand backside for a grand ship. Perfect for leaving yer enemies in yer wake.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_rib_wood_desc: A Hull-Rib Side piece. Useful for building realistic hulls. A reinforced vertical support rib structure essential for bearing structural loads. <color=yellow>Thick ribs for a thick ship. Let's see a troll try to punch through this.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_rib_aft_center_woo: Nailed Hull Rear Counter Stern - center
valheim_vehicles_hull_seal_bow_right_woo: Seals the front nose of the vehicle when using prow variants. A heavy starboard-side floorboard designed to securely seal the curved aft section. <color=yellow>Nothin' gets past this plank, not even the foulest sea-spray.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_rib_aft_left_wood: Nailed Hull Rear Counter Stern - Left
valheim_vehicles_hull_rib_corner_floor_w: Will seal off the ship's rib corner gap. A tailored port-side floorboard designed to seamlessly cover the curved framing at the rear. <color=yellow>No one likes a drafty stern. Nail it down proper!</color>
mb_pier_pole_desc: Pier support that is built on water and automatically extends all the way to the sea floor. A sturdy, resin-coated wooden log support for coastal docks. <color=yellow>Slathered in enough resin to keep the barnacles guessing.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_rib_corner_wood_ri: Will seal off the ship when used with a Hull Prow and a Hull Rib. A starboard-side forward framing element maintaining a watertight bow. <color=yellow>The starboard cheek of yer ship's face. Seal it well, or we'll be drinking the sea.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_bow_curved_right_w: A Hull-Rib Piece meant to be placed at the front of a ship. A heavy, nailed starboard-side framing piece crafted specifically for the aft quarter. <color=yellow>The starboard rear cheek. Keep it caulked, or the sea's coming in the back door.</color>
valheim_vehicles_mechanism_toggle_switch: Lever mechanism to access additional boat debug settings menu. Grants access to an advanced interface for configuring and modifying the ship's properties. <color=yellow>Fiddle with the architecture all ye want, just don't break the mesh colliders!</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_bow_center_wood_de: A Hull-Rib Piece meant to be placed at the front of a ship. A sturdy wooden bow frame serving as the primary impact point. <color=yellow>The sharp wooden prow that splits the ocean spray. Aim true and keep her steady.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_rib_corner_wood_le: Will seal off the ship when used with a Hull Prow and a Hull Rib. A port-side forward framing element maintaining a watertight bow. <color=yellow>The port-side cheek of yer ship's face. Slap enough resin on it to keep the damp out.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_slab_wood_4x4_desc: A Hull Slab made for ships. A broad, flat wooden panel coated in resin used to construct the primary walking surface. <color=yellow>A fine piece of deck to swab when the captain's in a foul mood. Get a mop!</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_rail_prow_corner_l: Keeps you in your ship. Works with all hulls and stacks. Make cages, elevators, or high walls using these. A precisely angled port-side rail designed to converge at the forwardmost prow. <color=yellow>Port-side protection. Keeps the spray outta yer eyes and you on the deck.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_seal_bow_left_wood: Seals the front nose of the vehicle when using prow variants. A heavy port-side floorboard designed to securely seal the curved aft section. <color=yellow>Fills the gaps like a good glob of tar.</color>
item_vessel_horn_desc: [Left-Click] Teleport to boat | [Middle-Click] Bind to boat | [Right-Click] Teleport to Sacrificial Stones. <color=yellow>Blow this when ye've lost yer vessel, or when the mead makes ye forget where ye parked it.</color>
valheim_vehicles_cannon_turret_tier1_des: An automatic turret cannon to defend your ship. Must be near a powder barrel and cannonball ammo in a storage container to fire. <color=yellow>Let the Surtling magic do the aiming while ye manage the sails!</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_rail_corner_wood_d: Keeps you in your ship. Works with all hulls and stacks. Make cages, elevators, or high walls using these. A smoothly curved railing segment built to wrap securely around the aft deck. <color=yellow>A smooth curve at the back to keep the captain from tumbling off during a storm.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_seal_tri_bow_left_: Seals the front nose of the vehicle when using prow variants. A specialized port-side panel nailed in place to provide a sealed bow surface. <color=yellow>Pointy end goes forward, try to remember that when yer laying it down.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_seal_corner_left_w: Seals the aft of the vehicle when using aft rib pieces. A reinforced port-side deck section custom-cut to cover the rear overhang structure. <color=yellow>Plug that hole, lest we invite the entire ocean into the hold!</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_rib_wood_2x2x2_des: A Hull-Rib Side piece. Useful for building realistic hulls. Made of basic Wood. A waterproofed vertical rib used to form the curved side walls. <color=yellow>Keeps the ocean on the outside and the sailors on the inside, exactly as the gods intended.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_bow_center_iron_de: A Hull-Rib Piece meant to be placed at the front of a ship. A heavy-duty, iron-plated bow frame serving as the primary impact point. <color=yellow>Forged iron plating to cleave the fiercest waves and crush any ice in yer path. Built like a fortress, swims like a shark.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_rail_straight_wood: Keeps you in your ship. Works with all hulls and stacks. Make cages, elevators, or high walls using these. An elongated railing segment spanning three lengths. <color=yellow>A long rail to lean on when the ocean gets a bit too choppy.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_prow_wood_2x2x4_de: A Hull-Rib Piece meant to be placed at the front of a ship. A heavily resined structural frame designed to form the leading edge of the ship's bow. <color=yellow>The very nose of yer vessel. Best make it strong to smash through those miserable ocean swells.</color>
valheim_vehicles_wheel_desc: Use the Vehicle Wheel to control the Vehicle it attaches to. Mount this on your deck to gain directional control over the ship's rudder systems. <color=yellow>Spin it to port, spin it to starboard, just keep us off the rocks, if ye please.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_floor_keel_4x2_lef: A slab with a hull keel. Meant to seamlessly connect with rib pieces. Typically used in center of vehicle. Aesthetic only outside of defensive properties. The critical lowest tier of side planking bolted directly to the main keel. <color=yellow>The bottom-most plank where all the filthy bilge water pools. Try not to drink it.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_seal_corner_left_w: Nailed Deck Counter Stern Planking - Left
valheim_vehicles_hull_floor_4x4_wood_des: A Hull Slab made for ships. Heavy-duty decking reinforced with bronze nails, creating a highly durable walking surface. <color=yellow>Solid enough to dance a jig on, provided ye haven't had too much fermented honey.</color>
mb_boarding_ramp_desc: Extend and retract the ramp. Adjust number of segments. A retractable wooden walkway for boarding the ship from a dock or shoreline. <color=yellow>A fine walkway to strut aboard with yer hard-earned loot.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_rib_corner_floor_w: Will seal off the ship's rib corner gap. A tailored starboard-side floorboard designed to seamlessly cover the curved framing at the rear. <color=yellow>Fits snug as a bug in a rug, assuming the bug is a heavily armed Viking.</color>
valheim_vehicles_cannon_control_center_d: Controls firing angle of fixed and auto cannons. The central artillery command station used to manually aim and trigger all connected fixed cannons. <color=yellow>The nerve center for our glorious destruction. Give 'em hell, gunner!</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_seal_corner_right_: Seals the aft of the vehicle when using aft rib pieces. A reinforced starboard-side deck section custom-cut to cover the rear overhang structure. <color=yellow>Final piece of the stern puzzle. A job well done.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_rib_corner_wood_2x: Will seal off the ship when used with a Hull Prow and a Hull Rib. A curved, waterproofed framing piece that connects the side ribs to the aft structure. <color=yellow>Patch that corner tight, or we'll be bailing water till our arms fall off.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_rail_prow_corner_r: Keeps you in your ship. Works with all hulls and stacks. Make cages, elevators, or high walls using these. A precisely angled starboard-side rail designed to converge at the forwardmost prow. <color=yellow>Starboard-side protection. Don't go leaning too far over, now.</color>
mb_pier_stone_desc: Pier support that is built on water and automatically extends all the way to the sea floor. A massive masonry column used for constructing deep-water docks. <color=yellow>Heavy rocks for a heavy dock. Drop 'em straight and true.</color>
valheim_vehicles_powder_barrel_desc: A Keg filled with explosive powder to fuel nearby cannons. A combustible storage container essential for naval combat. <color=yellow>Keep yer torches away from this, unless ye fancy an early trip to Valhalla.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_seal_corner_right_: Nailed Deck Counter Stern Planking - Right
valheim_vehicles_hull_bow_curved_left_wo: A Hull-Rib Piece meant to be placed at the front of a ship. A heavy, nailed port-side framing piece crafted specifically for the aft quarter. <color=yellow>Slaps right onto the aft port quarter. Mind the curve as ye build!</color>
mb_raft_mast_desc: A tattered sail to harness the wind. +[3] sailing speed. A large, stitched hide sail supported by a core wood mast to propel the ship. <color=yellow>Pray to Njord for a tailwind, 'cause this patched-up rag won't do all the work for ye.</color>
valheim_vehicles_ship_anchor_desc: A hefty Anchor. A deployable weighted anchor made of stone and core wood used to lock the ship securely in place. <color=yellow>Drop this rock to stay put. Just remember to heave the blasted thing up before ye set sail again!</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_rail_connector_woo: Keeps you in your ship. Works with all hulls and stacks. Make cages, elevators, or high walls using these. A short, modular railing segment. <color=yellow>A small barricade to keep the crew from tumbling into the surf.</color>
mb_rope_anchor_desc: A mount to secure rope rigging to. Crucial for securing dock lines, sails, and other tension-bearing rope systems. <color=yellow>Tie it off right with a proper knot, lest our sails blow away!</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_center_wood_desc: A sea-sturdy center hull piece. Time to build a sturdy ship. Made of basic Wood. A structural extension piece used to lengthen the main keel. <color=yellow>More belly for the beast. Keep it tight, unless ye like a soggy cargo hold.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_center_iron_desc: A sturdy center hull piece reinforced with iron bands used to lengthen the main keel. <color=yellow>Heavy iron backbone to split the sea and steady the load.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_slab_iron_2x2_desc: A compact Hull Slab reinforced with iron bands and rivets. Heavy-duty deck flooring suited for tight walkways and armored holds. <color=yellow>Narrow iron-reinforced planks to walk upon. Sturdy enough to withstand the heaviest troll blows.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_slab_iron_4x4_desc: A wide Hull Slab reinforced with sturdy iron plating. Creates a reinforced, fire-resistant deck surface for mighty sea vessels. <color=yellow>Broad iron-reinforced deck plates to form the core floor of yer fortress ship.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_wall_iron_2x2_desc: A small structural wall frame reinforced with iron strapping. Ideal for bulkheads, cabins, and interior partitions. <color=yellow>Compact iron-reinforced walling to divide yer quarters and seal out the spray.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_wall_iron_4x4_desc: A full-sized vertical frame wall plated with solid iron bands. Provides heavy protection and structural integrity for upper decks and cabins. <color=yellow>Heavy iron-reinforced bulkheads to shield yer crew from storm and arrow alike.</color>
valheim_vehicles_window_wall_porthole_2x: A reinforced iron wall section fitted with a watertight round porthole. Perfect for viewing the swells from tight quarters. <color=yellow>A small peephole into the deep. Keep it latched during rough seas!</color>
valheim_vehicles_window_wall_porthole_4x: A full-sized iron bulkhead featuring a centered naval porthole. Combines armored protection with natural sea light. <color=yellow>Watch the serpents circle yer vessel without catching an ocean wave to the face.</color>
valheim_vehicles_window_wall_porthole_8x: An expansive iron wall section mounted with dual naval portholes. Provides panoramic ocean vistas along the ship's broadside. <color=yellow>Grand windows for the captain's quarters or gun deck gallery.</color>
valheim_vehicles_window_floor_porthole_4: A heavy iron floor hatch with a thick glazed inspection porthole. Allows you to peer directly into the ship's hold or down into the sea beneath. <color=yellow>Look down upon the abyss, or just check if the bilge is flooding again.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_floor_4x4_iron_des: A Hull Slab made for ships. Heavy-duty decking reinforced with iron straps and nails, creating an armored, blast-resistant walking surface. <color=yellow>Sturdy iron decking to hold the heaviest cannons and take the brunt of troll clubs without a splinter.</color>
valheim_vehicles_hull_floor_keel_4x2_lef: A slab with a hull keel. Meant to seamlessly connect with rib pieces. The critical lowest tier of side planking bolted directly to the main keel, reinforced with thick iron plating. <color=yellow>Heavy iron banding along the bilge line. Keeps the reef rocks from gutting yer belly like a trout.</color>
